top_signals.title: Pakistan Pledges to Honor Security Pact If Saudi Arabia Attacked
top_signals.summary: Pakistan’s Defense Minister Khawaja Asif said any attack on Saudi Arabia could activate the Mecca Defense Alliance, warning aggression against one member would be viewed as an attack on all signatories.
